more.thought: The team is built around a strong Steel-type defensive backbone (Archaludon, Gholdengo, Kingambit) supported by Intimidate utility from Incineroar. Primarina provides a powerful Water/Fairy special attacker with Calm Mind sweeping potential, while Rhyperior adds Ground/Rock physical coverage and a Stealth Rock alternative. Items are distributed to maximize type-specific boosts (Mystic Water, Soft Sand, Expert Belt) without overlap, and EVs are tuned for each role: defensive pivots get HP+SpD or HP+Spe, sweepers get max offensive investment with bulk to survive hits.
